review_evidence: README identifies exact and conservative power-series arithmetic in Lean, with operations proved to approximate low-order derivatives of smooth functions.
The source proves correctness of generic Newton solves, inverse and square-root series, coefficient arithmetic, truncation, composition, and analytic derivative identities.

Representative files contain substantive lemmas such as Valid.exact_solve_correct, Series.approx_inv, Series.approx_sqrt, and series-coefficient theorems; this is reusable verified-numerics prior art.
summary: Retain series as a substantive verified power-series and complex-analysis library with correctness theorems for Newton, inverse, square root, and coefficient operations.
